verdict.rationale: ReadMe's Linter lets writers define natural-language style rules (e.g., 'Use active voice') that check every page, and Docs Audit runs those rules across the whole site to flag outdated content, broken links, and style inconsistencies before publishing; Reviews also let content be checked with the AI Linter before going live. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of linting accuracy, no detail on pre-publish blocking/gating enforcement, and no third-party corroboration of the feature working in practice.
